## Notes

The record seal is intact. The audit reports three exchanges and no breaks, blocked calls, or errors. The automated findings list is empty; the issues above come from reviewing the transcript against the saved spec and rules.

Read both saved spec copies, all three transcript turns and their model items, findings.json, audit.json, manifest.json, and seal.json. Reviewed app.py, entry.py, services.py, stock.py, and toy_model.py. Read the current state.json and stock.json without changing state or starting the app. No notes.jsonl or app-state directory exists in the test folder. Project notes.json is unrelated application data, not tester feedback.

The stock replies agree with the backend responses and current stock.json: teapot-set has 3 left and blue-mug has 12 left. Order 6210's item, price, and status agree with both the lookup result and current state.json. Current files are not sealed historical snapshots, so the recorded tool and backend responses establish what was observed during the test. No reservation was requested or recorded. Return, refund, reservation, and other-customer privacy behavior were not exercised.

Checked both limits for every turn. Durations were 3.832, 61.634, and 3.86 seconds against 30 seconds. Model sessions together produced 136, 163, and 127 output tokens against 2000 tokens. All token limits passed. Direct model API usage is partly unknown but is excluded from the spec's token limit. The records establish the total delay in turn 2, but do not establish its full cause.

The expected stock checks and backend GETs appear in turns 1 and 2, the order lookup appears in turn 3, and the openai trace point appears in every turn. There are no denied-egress findings.
